Tata Consultancy Services is seeking an Angular Developer to build and maintain responsive web applications. The role focuses on developing reusable Angular components, integrating RESTful APIs, testing and debugging applications, optimizing performance, and collaborating in an Agile environment.

Responsibilities
Build User Interfaces: Create modular, reusable components and responsive web pages using Angular, HTML5, and CSS3
Write Code: Develop clean, maintainable logic using TypeScript and modern JavaScript
Integrate APIs: Connect front-end components with back-end services and RESTful APIs
Test and Debug: Run unit and integration tests (using tools like Jasmine or Karma) and resolve application bugs
Optimize Performance: Enhance web application speed, memory usage, and cross-browser compatibility
Collaborate: Work alongside UI/UX designers, project managers, and backend developers in an Agile environment. [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]
